journey.name: Lift: a superset, two blocks done in turn
journey.description: Two blocks of a program day are made a superset in the program editor (A1 and A2): the session takes a set of each in turn, round by round. Resting after both, A1 goes straight on to A2 with no rest timer, A2's set-up said at once, and the pair rests after A2; resting after each, every set rests. Today's plan marks the pair. Run with the Voice switch on in Settings.

actions.action: Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength", then "Follow a program", find "Goblet squat and row", tap it and then "Follow this program"
Tap "All programs", tap "Goblet squat and row", then "Make it yours"
Tap the "Goblet squat" block, verify that the sheet shows "Superset with Row" with Off, "Rest after both" and "Rest after each", tap "Rest after both" and then "Done"
Verify that the goblet squat's row reads "A1 · with Row · rest after the pair" and the row's "A2 · with Goblet squat · rest after the pair"
Tap "Save program", go back, and tap "Start day 1"
Verify that Up next reads "1 of 9 sets", the goblet squat, with "A1 · straight on to Row"

Tap "Log set" and verify that no rest counts down, that Up next is the row's left side ("2 of 9 sets", "A2 · with Goblet squat · rest after the pair") and that the row's set-up ("Brace a hand on a bench with a flat back") is said at once
Log the row's two sides and verify that a rest counts down after the right, then that Up next is the goblet squat again ("4 of 9 sets")
Tap "Today's plan" and verify that both blocks are marked A1 and A2
